summary.text: Sue Lee Loy (listed by Ballotpedia as Susan Lee Loy) is a Democratic member of the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 2, who took office on November 5, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Lee Loy succeeded Richard Onishi in District 2 after the 2024 election.
For 2025-2026 she serves on the Finance Committee, the Human Services and Homelessness Committee, and as vice chair of the Committee on Health.
She defeated Cristina Holt in the August 8, 2026 Democratic primary, 74.6 percent to 25.4 percent, and faces Republican Jonathan Kennealy in the general election.
